notes.title: KELDER – Major Update 1.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I’ve been observing and taking notes from your gameplay and feedback, and working really hard to deliver this [b]major update[/b] in a short time. This patch brings a lot of new content, system improvements, and bug fixes that should make the experience smoother, scarier, and more immersive.[/p][p]                       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/d7a135e269cef841a1727b0a5952926847b45ba5.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Top Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Journal System[/b] – keeps track of thoughts, tasks, and hints, with a UI notification for new notes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Tutorial Section[/b] – learn the core mechanics through an integrated tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Entities[/b] – each with unique stories and behaviours.[/p][/*][*][p][b]80+ New Events[/b] – complete overhaul of encounters and event system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Overhaul[/b] – updated global illumination and post-processing for more comfortable visuals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Levels[/b] – new paths, rooms, and more save points across multiple levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard Key binding[/b] – players can now rebind their keys.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Journal system[/b] for player thoughts, tasks, and hints.[/p][/*][*][p]Journal UI updates when a new note is added.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]full tutorial section[/b] with UI integration.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]3 new entities[/b] with unique stories and behaviours.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]~80 new events[/b] with a complete overhaul of the encounter system.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay & Systems[/h3][list][*][p]Save system updated with more save points and locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Save UI now notifies players when progress is saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Save system improved to prevent rare softlock cases on critical paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now [b]rebind keyboard keys[/b] from the controls menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical events rebalanced and updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p][b]Level 0[/b] slightly updated; location changes in location of Map 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 1[/b] updated with a new critical path at the end.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 2[/b] expanded with more save points.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 3[/b] extended with a large new room.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Character camera [b]post-processing[/b] updated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Global illumination[/b] completely overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player vision[/b] adjusted for short-distance visibility in low light.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PODV entity[/b] improved with new behaviour, effects, and encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Darkness entity[/b] updated with better interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chairguy[/b] updated with improved door interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radio[/b] modified with better responses and fixed rare incorrect lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player sound system[/b] updated for more accurate sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed subtitle errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction objects are now more responsive.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: KELDER – Development Update & Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This past weekend, [b]KELDER[/b] went live and many gamers and streamers had the chance to experience it. I've been carefully watching playthroughs, reading feedback, and taking notes on what worked and what needs improvement.[/p][p]I want to share that [b]KELDER[/b] will continue to receive [b]regular updates[/b] until it fully becomes the ultimate horror experience I envision. Some content had to be cut due to time constraints, but I plan to reintroduce parts of it, expand on what's already there, and refine the overall experience to deliver a more intense and consistent sense of horror. I also aim to add additional language support so more players can experience [b]KELDER.[/b][/p][p]Here's a look at what's coming in future updates:[/p][p]    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/3b905b29c2e390e833db639576823981fc9483bc.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Upcoming Changes & Additions[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Entity Improvements[/b] – Smarter, more dynamic behavior for certain entities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Areas[/b] – Some locations will be extended with new details and surprises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Micro-Events[/b] – Additional random encounters in pathways to keep players on edge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Path Enhancements[/b] – More dynamics and clearer navigation hints.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] – More languages will be added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cut Content Returns[/b] – A few previously cut entities will be reintroduced (their documents and hints are already in-game).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster AI Upgrades[/b] – Both main monsters will become more responsive, adaptive, and engaged with the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Events[/b] – Hidden environmental scares to reward exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Readable Notes[/b] – More in-world notes to expand lore and improve immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable Controls[/b] – More rebindable options for comfortable play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Summary[/b] – Final results screen at the end of each run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Global Controller System[/b] – A refined feature that ensures every encounter is random, but now with more adaptive and sophisticated control tailored to each player's journey.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This is just the beginning. I'll be working continuously to shape [i]KELDER[/i] into the horror experience it's meant to be. Thank you all for playing, streaming, and sharing your thoughts. Your feedback is driving the next phase of development, and I can't wait to show you what's next.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and stay in the dark.[/p]

notes.title: KELDER is Here!
notes.notes: [p][b]KELDER is finally here![/b][/p][p]After years of work, late nights, and endless cups of coffee, we're thrilled to share KELDER with you. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="cZuuk3TaZQs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This journey has been long and challenging, but every moment was dedicated to creating a truly immersive horror experience. Step into a tense and atmospheric world filled with dark secrets, strange entities, and unpredictable events. [/p][p][/p][p]Every step you take could be calm… or it could turn into pure chaos. The game adapts to you, keeping you on edge with unscripted scares and dynamic encounters. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover mysteries as you try to survive the horrors lurking in the depths.[/p][p][/p][p]KELDER isn't just a game — it's an experience that reacts to you, making every moment unique, every walk unpredictable, and every discovery unforgettable. Are you ready to descend into the Kelder?[/p]

notes.title: KELDER Launches Tomorrow
notes.notes:
[p]It’s an exciting moment to reach this point after many months of work, [b]KELDER[/b] is finally ready to be played.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/0d1ced6b64f8f969008036f64b21dcec9e8b9530.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Built entirely from scratch, optimized, tested, and polished, the game is now set for release.[/p][p]Tomorrow, the doors will open and the journey will begin.[/p][p][/p][p]Get yourself ready for the truly atmospheric horror[/p][p]
Thank you for your support and patience—see you inside KELDER.[/p]

notes.title: KELDER releases in 15 days! The build is approved and ready
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="gKP-QBwkMz8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re officially 15 days away from the release of [b]KELDER[/b]!
Steam has approved the build without any issues — the game is locked in and ready to launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, I'm focusing on polishing a few areas, tightening up the experience, and hunting down any lingering bugs. We’re still testing and recording edge cases — especially the [i]weird and unique[/i] interactions that make [b]KELDER[/b]… well, [b]KELDER[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]One of the game’s core features is that it [b]randomizes interactions every time you play[/b]. Even I still get surprised (and spooked) by what happens. No two runs are the same.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a long journey to this point. After all the late nights and endless tweaking, it's strange to finally catch a small breath — but don’t worry, I’m still working hard to make sure everything is as polished and creepy as it should be at launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking around — and if you haven’t already, be sure to [b]wishlist KELDER[/b] to be notified when it drops![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the basement.[/p][p][/p][p]– THOs Dev[/p]

notes.title: "KELDER" is Nearing to its Final Stage
notes.notes:
[h2]KELDER Nears Completion — A New Kind of Horror[/h2][p]Hey everyone,
This is [b]THOs Developer[/b], and I wanted to give you a proper update on where things stand with [b]KELDER[/b].[/p][p]I’ve been quiet lately, but only because we’ve been focused on finishing the game — and I’m excited to say:[/p][p]
[b]We’re nearly there.[/b][/p][previewyoutube="P021hsxh1Pg;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3]A Horror Game That Reacts to You[/h3][p]KELDER isn’t a linear horror experience — it’s designed to feel [b]unpredictable and personal[/b] every time you play.[/p][p]The game uses a unique system where [b]interactions, scares, and events are randomized[/b].
That means the timing, location, and nature of many moments are [b]decided dynamically[/b], based on your choices and how long you spend in certain areas.[/p][p]No two playthroughs are the same — the game shapes itself as you explore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/95dfa85f1fa9d375fad6a9b5258720bad99591f0.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]A Deeper Experience[/h3][p]KELDER is a [b]single-player psychological horror game[/b] with a strong focus on story, atmosphere, and discovery.
It’s not just about getting scared — it’s about [b]uncovering strange events[/b], reading unsettling notes, and interacting with entities[b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/880df38410ef62c122f9d401500f0bcb60237fc9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Where We’re At Now[/h3][p][/p][p]The game is in its [b]final development stage[/b].
We’re currently polishing mechanics, refining interactions, and finishing the narrative so everything feels cohesive and impactful.[/p][p]If you’ve played the demo: [b]Thank you.[/b]
If not — it’s still up, and gives a solid preview of what to expect (though the full game goes much further).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/615deb851b81e384346c6188803e2edf04150944.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📢 What’s Coming Next?[/h3][p]Over the next weeks, we’ll be sharing:[/p][list][*][p]A new trailer[/p][/*][*][p]Final release date[/p][/*][*][p]More gameplay footage[/p][/*][*][p]Developer insights [/p][/*][*][p]Cool short videos of gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p]➡️ [b]Wishlist KELDER[/b] if you haven’t already — it really helps!
And follow us on social media for more updates, sneak peeks, and weird things.[/p][p]Thanks for following the journey. We're almost there.[/p][p]— [b]THOs Developer[/b]
[i]Creator of KELDER[/i][/p]
